desc: An intact farming village of a few houses on flat grassland. The road runs here; there is a square. Young animals about. Wind; cold air. Cracked ground here and there. Very likely this is the "plain town" seen at middle distance from everywhere east and south of here.
name: Grassland village
notes: "go to plain town" brought us here, and the looks went straight to repeating the temple, as they did when we left. Map scale: short walk = 1 square, long = 2, a morning's walk = 3; all rough.
statusNote: Houses, square and road unexamined. Temple entered but dark.
